e.title: insurance-credibility
e.summary: 可信度模型定价（burning-cost，MIT）：Bühlmann-Straub 与贝叶斯可信度
e.body: insurance-credibility（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）实现 UK 非寿险定价的可信度模型：Bühlmann-Straub 与贝叶斯可信度（credibility）——经典精算理论（经验数据 + 先验的加权）。对 RIAA：可信度理论的工程实现——经典精算概念（[[credibility-gated-xai]] 的可信度门控同源）；与 [[insurancerating]]（R 定价）配套；理解「经验可信度加权」如何落地（小样本险种/新业务定价）；费率制定课程（[[rim540]]）的经典方法工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（可信度模型，MIT），未实测
e.summary_en: Credibility-model pricing (burning-cost, MIT): Buehlmann-Straub and Bayesian credibility
e.summary_hk: 可信度模型定價（burning-cost，MIT）：Bühlmann-Straub 與貝葉斯可信度
e.body_en: insurance-credibility (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) implements credibility models for UK non-life pricing: Buehlmann-Straub and Bayesian credibility — a classic actuarial theory (weighting of experience data + prior). For RIAA: the engineering implementation of credibility theory — sharing the credibility-gating lineage of [[credibility-gated-xai]]; with [[insurancerating]] (R pricing) it supports the pricing workflow; understand how 'experience-credibility weighting' lands (small-sample lines/new-business pricing); a classic-method tool for the ratemaking course ([[rim540]]).
e.body_hk: insurance-credibility（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）實現 UK 非壽險定價的可信度模型：Bühlmann-Straub 與貝葉斯可信度（credibility）——經典精算理論（經驗數據 + 先驗的加權）。對 RIAA：可信度理論的工程實現——經典精算概念（[[credibility-gated-xai]] 的可信度門控同源）；與 [[insurancerating]]（R 定價）配套；理解「經驗可信度加權」如何落地（小樣本險種/新業務定價）；費率制定課程（[[rim540]]）的經典方法工具。
